_comment: Auto-orient walking entities to face their direction of motion. Opt-in via tag 'face_motion'. Splice into a game's rules.json with {$include: '@lib.motion.face_motion.rules'}.
_convention: Mesh-forward in Yume is -Z. Yaw rotates CCW around UP. velocity in this bundle is Vector2 [vx, vy] where vy = world Z (floor-walkers per data-demo.md). yaw = atan2(vx, -vz) maps motion direction onto the mesh's forward axis.
_gate: Rule fires for every entity tagged face_motion every sim-tick. Inside the formula a clamp-based step (1 when |v|²>0.01, i.e. |v|>0.1; 0 below) gates the rotation: moving → snap yaw to motion direction; stopped → keep current yaw. Ternary-free (Yume's Expression has a broken ternary per data-demo.md), composed as `yaw + weight * (target - yaw)`.

rules._comment: Tick at interval=1 — at Aldenmere's 60Hz this is per-frame smoothness. Slower-tick games may bump interval to 2-3 without visible jitter (humanoids don't turn fast enough to notice 30Hz facing updates).
